alerts.text: High winds and heavy rain are expected today. This may cause delays, detours or service suspensions. Please allow extra travel time. Check septa.org/alerts for the latest information and use plan.septa.org to find alternate routes. We encourage Regional Rail riders to familiarize themselves with designated alternate bus and Metro routes in case of disruptions.

Sunday Schedule in Effect for Thanksgiving Day Bus, Metro and Regional Rail routes operate on a Sunday schedule on Thanksgiving Day . Routes that do not have Sunday schedules do not operate. All modes resume regular weekday schedule at the start of service day, Friday, November 27.

All modes resume regular weekday schedule at the start of service day, Friday, November 27. Additionally, no overnight parking is allowed at Chestnut Hill East Station until construction is completed.
